visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair wearing a beige cardigan and black top stands indoors, looking slightly distressed as she speaks directly to the camera in a selfie view. Behind her is a fire extinguisher and a yellow safety sign on a tiled floor. (2) She transitions to walking through a modern airport terminal with large windows and bright lighting. She turns the camera to show two younger girls following behind her; one is in a light green puffer jacket and the other in a cream sweater. (3) The scene shifts to the younger girl in the green jacket leaning against a metal counter, seemingly filling out forms with a focused expression. Later, she is seen sitting on a large black suitcase reading a book in a seating area. (4) The narrator continues talking in close-up, now appearing more calm. The girl in the green jacket is then seen using a traditional wall-mounted airport telephone while holding documents. (5) In the final phase, the girl in the green jacket is smiling brightly, pulling a large pink suitcase through the terminal, indicating the issue has been resolved, as they walk toward the exit.
